messages.author: b0b4143f3aaa7ee5
messages.subject: Using 1000G LD Scores
parts:
Has anyone tried using the 1000G calculated LD scores, for example the ones available at https://alkesgroup.broadinstitute.org/LDSCORE/? I'm trying the '1000G_Phase3_baseline_v1.2_ldscores' files. Although when trying to use these ld scores (after changing the names to match what GenomicSEM expects), I get the error:

Error in FUN(X[[i]], ...) :
  only defined on a data frame with all numeric variables
Calls: ldsc -> Summary.data.frame -> lapply -> FUN
Execution halted

Any suggestions? Any other 1000G ld scores references that are available?


Thanks,
Ravi

messages.author: d6d83e22ef3ba9f1
messages.subject: Re: Using 1000G LD Scores
parts:
Hi Ravi, 

Are you using the 1000G calculated LD scores to run LD-score regression (ldsc function in Genomic SEM) or the newer Stratified LDSC feature(s_ldsc function in Genomic SEM)? If you are using the LD scores for traditional LDSC you should be using the file "eur_w_ld_chr" available through the same link you listed or through the Genomic SEM box folder at: https://utexas.app.box.com/s/vkd36n197m8klbaio3yzoxsee6sxo11v

If you are running s_ldsc I would recommend using  1000G_Phase3_baselineLD_v2.2_ldscores.tgz as some of the earlier baseline versions (such as the v1.2 version you downloaded) the group provides can provide underestimates of total population heritability based on some internal simulations we've performed and reflect the most up-to-date versions recommended by the group at the Broad. Of course let us know if you are still running into error messages or issues. 

Best, 
  Andrew
